heading: Committee Discusses Temporary Data Center Moratorium
summary: Alders considered directing staff to draft a temporary pause on data center development. The proposal would give the city time to address public facilities and other concerns in its ordinances. Staff outlined the path through the Planning Commission and Common Council.

heading: Council Authorizes Up to $12 Million in Promissory Notes
summary: The Common Council voted 8–0 to authorize up to $12.025 million in general obligation promissory notes. The resolution set parameters for the sale. The financing was part of the city's 2026 capital program.
